headings.text: Funkel Labs designs and builds web, mobile and AI products, from first idea to launch day.
Bring us an idea and leave with a product people can use: scoped, designed, built and launched.
Fast, accessible web applications, and the backends and APIs behind them.
iOS and Android apps that feel at home in the hand.
LLM features and automation that do real work inside your product, not demos bolted onto the side.
A few of the apps we’ve designed and built.
Funkel is German for sparkle: the moment a product stops being a plan and starts to feel alive.
